claim: The NixOS manual's canonical switch action order includes 'Reload systemd user instances (systemctl --user daemon-reload)' as a first-class step, but the chapter does not document the per-user restart pass that stc-ng implements — the manual's step list is at summary level.
stance_target: gap-03 documentation trail: manual corroborates user-instance handling on switch but omits restart details found in source and PRs
quoted_support: The order of actions is always the same: ... Reload systemd (`systemctl daemon-reload`) - Reload systemd user instances (`systemctl --user daemon-reload`) - Reactivate sysinit ... Restart units (`systemctl restart`) - Start units (`systemctl start`)
